      include 'spp.inc'

      s   = sin(theta_cm)
      c   = cos(theta_cm)
      s2  = sin(theta_cm/2.0)
      c2  = cos(theta_cm/2.0)

      hh1 = 0.0
      hh2 = 0.0
      hh3 = 0.0
      hh4 = 0.0
      hh5 = 0.0

      if(method_helicity.eq.1) then

	hh1 = -s*c2*(ff3 + ff4)/root2
	hh2 =  c2*((ff2 - ff1) + 0.5*(1 - c)*(ff3 - ff4))*root2

	    factor = 0.141383d0 * nu_cm / qv_mag_cm
